284841082.description: This bulk lot features a collection of assorted tumbled and polished stones and crystals in various colors, shapes, and sizes. The collection includes a mix of semi-precious stones with both natural and polished finishes, with some pieces featuring engraving or shaping, such as a brown stone inscribed with the word 'Love.' The stones are in good condition and come together as a comprehensive collection for enthusiasts and collectors.

284464348.description:
Natural geode with a rough tan and beige exterior and a sparkling white crystalline interior. The geode measures approximately 16 cm wide and 12 cm tall. The crystals inside are clear to milky white, featuring visible clusters and a central flat crystal formation. The geode is unpolished and in used, natural condition with minor chips and rough edges typical of this type of specimen. Suitable for display, collection, or educational purposes.

Can not verify Gemstone authenticity. Sold as is.

284607762.description:
Geode & Mineral Specimen Lot
Natural & Polished Crystals, Agate Bookends
Diverse collection of natural and polished geological specimens weighing approximately 18 pounds. This assemblage includes decorative display pieces and mineral specimens featuring distinct crystal habits, vibrant colors, and banding ideal for display or study.
Items Included:
2 pairs of cut agate bookends (green banded pair and natural matrix pair)
Celestite crystal geode cluster with light blue tabular crystals
Hollow quartz geode with sparkling crystal interior cavity
Amethyst geode section featuring purple crystal formation
Polished blue agate slice and small dyed blue geode piece
Pair of small matching quartz geode halves
Cleaved calcite spar crystal and knapped stone point
Assorted raw stones, jasper pebbles, and nodules
Condition:
Specimens show typical natural stone features with rough matrix exteriors and polished face cuts. Crystal interiors are intact with no post-extraction damage noted.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
